title: Automated evidence curation & release gating roadmap for compliance onboarding
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Goal: build an automated evidence curation pipeline and a deterministic release gating mechanism that reduces manual evidence collection for SOC2/ISO onboarding by >70% and prevents feature cutovers when compliance gates are not satisfied. Scope includes audit-log snapshot tooling, SSO/SAML configuration validators, control-to-evidence mapping, auditor-export bundles, and a Release Gate service that enforces evidence completeness and smoke-test pass rates before tenant cutover.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence pipeline can produce a signed audit bundle (.tar.gz) containing configuration snapshots and log extracts for one tenant in <10 minutes
Release Gate rejects a canary rollout when required evidence is missing or stale and surfaces clear remediation steps in the console
Control mapping UI shows 1:1 mapping from control IDs to evidence artifacts and the mapping can be exported as CSV
SAML/SSO validator performs pre-cutover dry-run and reports configuration drift against our golden policy
Encryption of exported bundles meets KMS usage and key rotation policy documented in the runbook
updates: 2026-01-09: Ticket created after cross-functional kickoff (PM, Eng, Security). Initial success metrics defined and SLA goals drafted.
2026-01-18: Security review session — agreed that exported bundles must be signed with customer KMS keys when available. Action: ENG-11009 to prototype KMS signer for snapshots.
2026-01-26: Design pass complete. Design noted need for an evidence index (metadata-first) rather than monolithic snapshots to support diffs and incremental replays.

2026-02-02: Engineering spike (ENG-8421) validated feasibility of extracting 30-day audit log slices with existing retention tooling; found perf hotspot in index queries. Decision: add lightweight per-tenant materialized view.
2026-02-10: PM review with Customer Success — prioritized tenant-export UX and CLI for managed onboarding; added 'auditor export CLI' to MVP.

2026-02-17: Blocker identified: Dedicated deployments with restricted egress require offline bundle creation flow. Added subtask ENG-90012 for on-prem bundle agent. Temporary workaround documented in runbook.
2026-02-21: Roadmap updated — split roadmap into MVP (snapshot + basic gate) and Phase 2 (incremental diffs, automated remediation suggestions, audit portal).
risks: On-prem/offline bundle creation may require additional security attestations and legal review that could push timeline
Large tenants with high event volumes may exceed the 10 minute bundle SLA without further indexing work
If KMS integrations are delayed, exported bundles will need temporary signing fallback which has higher trust friction for auditors
notes: Proposed Release Gate contract: 'evidence:complete' boolean + 'evidence:staleness_days' metric + smoke-test pass rate >= 95%
Consider adding a read-only 'auditor' role in Console that can retrieve previously produced bundles and associated control mappings
UX: provide per-control drilldown showing last evidence timestamp, responsible owner, and remediation playbook link
